content: Saúl, reyga sulesad
Benjamín-dule-gwensak Quisʼye-nugad nue-nuga-nika maigusad. Quisʼde Abiel-machid, Zeror-e-wagwad. E-dad-dummad Afía-machi-Becoratʼye nugad. Bela wemala, Benjamín-e-waganad.
Quisʼde machi-nikad, Saúlʼye nugad. Saúl Israel-dule-bamaladba sapingwa-nued dakleged. De-ukinbali, mas-dummarbabalid, dule-bamalad ese gukinba warmaked.
Ibagwengine, Quis-ibe molimar-uayasuid yoggusad. Geb e-machi-Saúlʼga sogded: “Molimar-uayasuid be aminae. Bebo-naega, mai-wargwen be sede.”

Ar Saúl na e-maibo molimar-uayasuid-aminadmarsunnad. Efraín-yalaganba amiapmalanad. Gwen molimar-amisurmarsoggu, Salisa-yarse aibitemalad, agi amissurmarbalid. Geb, Saalim-yargi, Benjamín-yargi molimar-amiapmarbalinad, gwen amissurgusmalad.
Zuf-yarse mosmargua, Saúl na e-mai-ebo-gudiidga sogded: —Anmar gannar negse nae. Abakale, an-bab, moli-uayasuidmarba anmargi bur bukib-binsaalile.

E-mai abin-sogded: —Dummad, we-neggweburgi Bab-Dummad-e-dule-wargwen nuga-nikad maid. Bela ibmar-soged nue-napira sogdaed, gakansadasulid. Degisoggu, anmar daknae, abakale a anmarga sokalile, bia anmar molimar-uayasuid aminaoe.
Saúl ega sogded: —Nabir be sogendo. Ar anmar ese naele, ¿ibu anmar ega sedosunna? Madu saguyaba bar maisulid. Ibmar-ega-uked anmar satebalid.
E-mai abin-sogdebalid: —Wis mani an sediid. We-mani sunna an Bab-Dummad-e-dulega uked, adi, anmarga sogega, bia anmar moli aminaoe.

(Ar epennegwa, Israel-yargi dule-wargwen Bab-Dummadse ibmar-wisgunabiele, sogdedaed: “Anmar dule-negburgan-dakedse namala.” Ar epennegwa, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged, dule-negburgan-dakedye bileged).
Saúl sogdesunnad: —Nabirdo, anmar daknae. Weyob Saúl sogsagua, Bab-Dummad-e-dule-maid-neggweburse nadmalad.
Saúl, e-maibo neggwebur-igar-maidba nakmamaigua, yagan-dii-weenadapi abinguarmalad. Amarse egichidmalad: —¿Wegi, dule-negburgan-daked mai?

Yagan abin-sogdemalad: —Eye, be-iduar mai. Gwae be daknamala. Emiskwaa neggweburse nonikid. Dule-negburgan-daked, yar-mullugi-aila-matusulid-siidgi Bab-Dummadga-ibdurgan-ukleged dulemarga ogumaksokalid.

Ar bemar neggweburgi dogsamalale, dule-negburgan-daked aila-matusulidse mas-gunnaed-iduar be nabir abingumaloed. A-dule, mas-gunned-iduar, dulemarga Bab-Dummadga doggus-nuedye sogergebed. Ar dulemar, dule-negburgan-daked-sate mas-gunnosurmalad. Geb a-sorbali, mas-gunnega-ese-gollesmalad nabir mas-gutemaloed. Degisoggu, be emiskwaa namar, adi, be nabir dakdapmaloed.
Geb degine, Saúl e-maibo neggweburse dognadmalad. Neggweburgi dognadapmaladgi, Samuel aila-matusulid-siidse-nadapi abinguarmalad.
Saúl-nonikoed-iduar, Bab-Jehová, Samuelʼga ibmar-guoed sogsad:

“Oibosale, we-wachigi, dule-Benjamín-yargined an bese barmidagoed. A-dule, Israel-dulemar-e-dummadga be nugsaoed, adi, Filistea-dulemar-sabsur-negsemaidgi Israel-dulemar-ollor-imakegar. Ar Israel-dulemar na wiles-gorbukwad anse warmaksasoggu, an wiledaked.”
Samuel, Saúl-dani-daksagua, Bab-Jehová, Samuelʼga sogded: “We-dulegi an bega sunmaksad. We-dule, Israel-dulemar-e-dummadga megoed.”
Saúl neggwebur-yawagak-mosgua, Samuel-abingunonikid, geb ese egichided: —Sunna be anga sogsale, ¿bia dule-negburgan-daked mai?
Samuel abin-sogded: —Ani an a-duled. Be anba yar-mullugi aila-matusulidse be dage. Emi bemar anba mas-gunmaloed. Oibosale, an be-barmidsokalile, be-anse-ibmar-egisbied an bega sogoed.
Ar molimar-uayasuid ibapaagus bei-yoggusadgindina, mer be bukib-binsae, bato amismalad. Samuel ega sogdebalid: —Israel-dulemar bur-ibmar-abedimalad, begadga guoed, degi, be-gwenadganga gumogoed.

Saúl abin-sogded: —¿Ibiga deyob be anga soge? ¿Ar ande, Benjamín-wagwasursi? ¿Ar Benjamín-dulemarde, Israel-dulemar-sogambe-gakabogwad-abargi (12) bur-bipigwadsursi? Ar an-gwenadgande, Benjamín-e-wagan-abargi, ¿dule-nug-satemaladsursi?
Geb Samuel eba Saúl-sesad, degi, eba Saúl-e-mai-sesbalid. Negyaba-odosgua, dulemar-abargi, dule-dummagan-sigmaladgi osilesmalad. A-negyabali, dulemar durgwen-gakambe-wilub (30) bukwamalad.
A-sorbali, Samuel dule-masduedga sogded: —An bega san-sabogega-uksa-gusad be sedage.

Dule-masdued sibad-wawaad-e-dua-gogwen senonikid. Geb Saúl-asabin mesisad. Degine, Samuel, Saúlʼga sogded: —Bega-san-sabolesad be-asabin-maid be gunne. Ar dule-bamalad mas-gunmaloed-iduar be gunne. We-ibaga bato bega san sabolesmaid. Weyobi, a-ibagi, Samuel, Saúlʼbo mas-guchad.
A-sorbali, yar-mullugi-bukwa neggweburse-aidearmalad. Geb Samuel, Saúlʼbo e-neg-birgi gabedneg-siidgi sunmaksad.
Neg-oibosgu, bolegoedba, Samuel neg-birgi gabedneg-siidgi goted. Agine, Samuel, Saúlʼga sogded: —Gwisgue. Bato naed be ogusad. Degine, Saúl gwisgusad, geb Samuelʼbogwa neggi noarmalad.
Neggwebur-noedse modapmargua, Samuel, Saúlʼga sogded: —Be-maiga be soge, be-idugwerye. Bedi sikwas abitogwelo. An bega Bab-Dummad-ibmar-sogsad soggwelo. Geb degi, Saúl-e-maidi, Saúl-idu nadsunnad.
